FN-B8H6JQ4-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 132
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 132 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Social
Work Examiners until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
